description.value: This pilot study examined associations between cannabis use and brain structure in older adults using structural magnetic resonance imaging, comparing current cannabis users with nonusers while accounting for age and depression symptoms.

spans.text: This pilot study assessed structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in adults 60 years and older who were either current cannabis users or nonusers.

description.value: Cross-sectional observational comparison of older adult current cannabis users and nonusers.

spans.text: The current study was tightly focused on older adults, but also attempted to address several pitfalls that have limited prior research examining associations between cannabis use and brain structure
Adults aged 60 years and older who reported consuming cannabis at least once per week for at least the last year ( n = 28) or who reported never using cannabis ( n = 28) were recruited
